rationale.complete: Round 1 done: synthetic validation, 16 per-period verdicts, spanning tests, post-hoc robustness and a scorecard. The confirmatory holdout script is written and dry-run but not run, and the response measure needs a round-2 replacement.
rationale.faithfulness: Dilution beats the no-budget null on held-out data in 16/16 periods and survives exogenous k in #51 (C = 1, H = 1). But the literal 1/k budget, mention bypass and the merge failed, recency is not separated in small periods, and the ground-truth placebo failed everywhere (G = 0).
rationale.usefulness: A computable scaling rule (per-pair engagement ~ N^-0.6, per-turn output conserved) that an operator could check on their own logs and use when sizing channels, with modest, mention-based evidence and no validated intervention.

one_line: Attention dilutes as ~k^-0.6 in all 16 periods (not 1/k): per-pair engagement falls with room size
